description:
S&P 500 breadth, derived aggregates only: the percent of index members above
their 20-, 50- and 200-day moving averages (0-100), a breadth zone for the 50- and
200-day readings (washed_out / weak / mixed / healthy / extended), advancers and
decliners, new 52-week highs and lows with the net count, the member count, and a
one-sentence read. The index level and its change are not published. stale is true
when the live read failed and the last stored close is served. Self-caching.
No parameters.
name: get_market_breadth
title: Get Market Breadth
